Name: Native Instruments Kontakt Libraries
Description: Sample content (.nicnt, .nkm, .nkc, .nkx) for the Kontakt sampler. The folder holds one subdirectory per library product and contains only sample/preset assets, no vendor installer scripts and no DLLs. Kontakt's library browser points at the absolute path, so symlinks are not used. no junctions are created for this entry.
